### Workspace and settings

- Arrange features in columns, rows, or tabs. Collapse a pane to its title or icons, drag a divider to resize adjacent panes, and undo layout changes. Sidebar and floating views keep their own presets.
- The desktop window’s green button maximizes and restores the window on the current desktop. The window, content, and material resize together.
- Settings follow ChatGPT’s appearance, with independent type controls for each surface. Feature switches are in one place, and previews appear above the settings they demonstrate.

### Conversation and tasks

- Browse the outline of a selected reply. Palboo prefers headings across the whole reply and uses a few local paragraph links when headings are absent.
- Short Quick Phrases can share a row. Settings also include interactive previews for Stepwise, terminology, and prompt enhancement.
- Save a merged or expanded task board layout across surfaces. Expanded groups stack vertically in narrow panels.
- When a model is unavailable with ChatGPT sign-in, Palboo explains the rejection and points to the custom API option.

### Grok Bot

- Open a Bot’s latest complete Markdown reply from Recent Messages and return to the list at the same position. Reading uses the local cache and preserves unread status.
- Draft a follow-up from a recent reply even after Palboo reloads. Follow-up text appends to your current draft and is ready for you to send.
- The settings preview reflects your configured Bot list, groups and pinned entries. Preview actions stay in the preview.

### Notes & Web

- Open saved web pages and authorized local folders in ChatGPT tabs. The reader supports multiple folders, search, Markdown editing with version-checked autosave, and spreadsheet previews.

### Model switching and compatibility

- Switch CLI agents directly in a new chat. From an existing chat, Palboo can save the visible conversation to local Markdown and prepare a handoff draft in a new chat.
- Configure CodexHost update checks at startup. Apply a staged update by explicitly restarting Codex from compatibility settings.

### 工作台与设置

- 功能可排成左右栏、上下栏或标签组。面板可折成标题或图标，拖动分隔线只调整相邻面板，也可撤销布局修改。侧栏与浮层各自保留预设。
- 桌面浮窗的绿色按钮可在当前桌面最大化和恢复。窗口、正文和材质同步缩放。
- 设置跟随 ChatGPT 的外观，各种承载形式可分别调整字体和字号。功能开关集中管理，预览放在对应配置上方。

### 对话与任务

- 可查看指定回复的大纲。优先采用整条回复里的原文标题，没有标题时补少量本地段落链接。
- 短常用语可以同行排列。设置页可直接试用下一步建议、术语卡片和提示词优化的交互预览。
- 看板可保存合并或完全展开视图，各承载同步。完全展开时，窄栏按组纵向排列。
- ChatGPT 登录不支持所选模型时，Palboo 会说明原因，并提示可使用指定 API。

### Grok Bot

- 从「最近消息」打开单个 Bot 最近一次完整 Markdown 回复，返回时恢复列表位置。阅读使用本机缓存，保留未读状态。
- Palboo 重载后，只要仍有可用的近期回复，就可以填入追问。追问追加到现有草稿，由你决定何时发送。
- 设置预览跟随已配置的 Bot 列表、分组和置顶项，演示操作留在预览中。

### 阅读与网页

- 在 ChatGPT 页签打开收藏网页和已授权的本地文件夹。阅读器支持多目录、搜索、Markdown 编辑与版本冲突检查，以及表格预览。

### 模型切换与兼容集成

- 新聊天可直接切换 CLI。已有聊天可将可见对话保存为本地 Markdown，并在新聊天预填接力草稿。
- 可设置启动时检查 CodexHost 更新，并在兼容集成页主动重启 Codex，应用已准备的更新。
